notes: Claude Code has no concept of an arbitrary custom provider -- it only speaks the Anthropic Messages API, selected globally via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN. Rather than mutate ~/.claude/settings.json (which would silently redirect every Claude Code session on the machine), the adapter generates an opt-in ~/.local/bin/claude-<provider-id> launcher that sets those env vars only for that invocation and execs the real `claude`, wired through the shared LiteLLM proxy.
